visual_summary: Inside a machinery-filled spacecraft or mechanical chamber, a helmeted woman with bloodied white gloves rages at a wounded, heavily augmented male figure she addresses as her son. She first boasts that she helped him win and threatens to make artificial fingers for his mother, then recoils from him and denounces the dishonorable way he won. As she argues, she physically grapples with him amid pipes and armor. She declares that by winning this way he has lost her and the whole clan of Metabarons, calls their shared dream finished, and tries to break away. In the final panels she embraces or clings to him, saying she will depart with him, while figures are hurled or drift into open blue space and a bright burst of energy or exhaust fills one panel.
